title: Japan’s U.S. Ties Could Not Save a Top Judge From Trump’s I.C.C. Sanctions
summary_full: Japan had tried to dissuade the U.S. from imposing sanctions on Tomoko Akane, president of the International Criminal Court, but the White House pressed ahead.
